field.label: Enable Server
field.help: Run the trusttunnel_endpoint daemon on this OPNsense.

field.label: Hostname
field.help: Public hostname clients connect to (matches the cert CN).

field.label: TLS certificate
field.help: Pick a cert from System → Trust → Certificates (issued by os-acme-client or self-signed).

field.label: Allowed custom SNI
field.help: Comma-separated exact SNI aliases. Do not use <label>.<main-host>; that syntax is reserved for SNI authentication.

field.label: Protocols
field.help: HTTP protocols to advertise. Default: http2,http3.

field.label: Allow private network connections
field.help: Required for site-to-site routing of LAN traffic.
